meta.title: External references (draft)
meta.notes: Outside seeds and third-party bias meters. Lean/left-right/Ground News-style axes are logged as references only and are NOT imported into scores. A call becomes a finding only after re-verify against a real source with quote+URL+date, tagged sample_frame=external_seed.

references.claim_summary: Naspers IEC gifts to ANC and DA amount to a character/structural conflict of interest for a news group that claims to hold power to account. Explicitly NOT asserted as a direct causal link to AfriForum packaging.
references.reason_not_mapped: No article quote, URL, or dated gift disclosure cited in the seed extract.
references.our_note: Structural COI awareness aligns with logging Media24/Naspers as owner_group in publications.csv; we also do not assert a causal link from ownership to AfriForum packaging. Kept as reference only.
references.seed_locator_note: Internal message identifiers and timestamps from the DM extract are kept only in the gitignored seed file, not in this public file.

references.claim_summary: Proposes Ground News–style axes adapted for SA: political lean, factuality record, target asymmetry, framing, ownership/COI awareness, blind spots; scale Left of SA media centre | Lean left | Centre | Lean right | Right of centre; factuality High/Mixed/Low.
references.reason_not_mapped: Axis/scale proposal only; methodology forbids importing left/right lean labels into scores.
references.our_note: Rejected for scoring. MediaWatch SA uses FOR/AGAINST named actors + drivers only. Factuality via Press Ombud/court/corrections can still enter as factual_error/correction findings when adjudicated.

references.claim_summary: Names Basson, du Toit, and Cowan as bias-meter subjects; method = bylines corpus, Press Council, columns, investigations; social accusations secondary.
references.reason_not_mapped: Subject list and method note without concrete article/post examples.
references.our_note: Basson and du Toit already in people.csv and News24 pilot. Cowan added this pass with a neutral May–Oct 2026 sample under method (not external_seed, because Cassian cited no example).
